items_flat.title_en: Amodei publishes ‘We Must Pace the Frontier’; Anthropic commits to embedded evaluators
items_flat.title_zh: Amodei發表〈必須調控前沿速度〉，Anthropic承諾嵌入第三方評估者
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published an essay arguing labs should slow the rate of capability gains so safety work can keep up, while saying this is not a halt to training. Anthropic unilaterally committed to step one: permanent, employee-level access for third-party evaluators (he cited METR) to check safety practices, report incidents, and assess alignment during training.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei發表長文，主張實驗室應放慢能力推進速度，讓安全工作跟上，並強調這不是停止訓練。Anthropic單方面承諾第一步：給第三方評估者永久、等同員工等級的系統存取，以核對安全措施、通報事故，並評估訓練過程中的對齊。
items_flat.analysis_en: The concrete change is verifiability inside the company, not a published training freeze. Whether other labs accept the same access terms, and whether ‘pacing’ changes release calendars, remains unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 真正落地的是公司內部可被核驗，而非已公布的訓練凍結。其他實驗室是否接受同等存取條件、以及「調速」會不會改變發布時程，目前都未證實。
items_flat.quote: We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models. Progress will still seem fast, and we must make wise use of the time we gain.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們必須放慢提升AI模型能力的速度。進展看起來仍會很快，我們必須善用爭取到的時間。

items_flat.title_en: Altman says OpenAI will match embedded evaluators and will not IPO in 2026
items_flat.title_zh: Altman：OpenAI將比照嵌入評估者，且2026年不會IPO
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman replied that he agrees the industry needs to pace the frontier and that OpenAI will also give independent evaluators employee-like access, with more detail later. In a Fortune interview circulating over the weekend he said a 2026 public listing would be ill-advised given current safety work, adding he would say not 2026.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI執行長Sam Altman回應稱同意必須調控前沿速度，OpenAI也將讓獨立評估者獲得近似員工的存取權，細節稍後公布。週末傳出的《Fortune》專訪中，他表示以目前安全工作來看，2026年上市並不適宜，並明確說「不會是2026」。
items_flat.analysis_en: Matching Anthropic’s slogan is easier than matching its access terms, publication rights, and any coordinated pause. The IPO delay is a financing-timeline signal, not evidence that OpenAI has already slowed a named training run.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 口頭對齊Anthropic，不等於接受同等存取條件、公開權，或協同暫停。延後IPO是融資時程訊號，並不能證明OpenAI已放慢某一具體訓練。
items_flat.quote: I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier. Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same. We'll have more to share soon.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我同意Dario，我們需要調控前沿速度。承諾讓獨立評估者擁有近似員工的存取權是好主意，我們也會這樣做。稍後會有更多說明。

items_flat.title_en: Grok models become selectable inside Microsoft Copilot
items_flat.summary_en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said more model choice is coming to Copilot and welcomed Grok; Elon Musk posted that Grok is available in Microsoft Copilot. Reporting describes a Frontier-program rollout across Word, Excel and PowerPoint that is off by default, admin-gated, and excluded from EU/EFTA/UK in preview, with models hosted under xAI terms rather than as general availability of Grok 4.7.
items_flat.summary_zh: 微軟執行長Satya Nadella表示Copilot將增加模型選擇並歡迎Grok；Elon Musk發文稱Grok已可在Microsoft Copilot使用。報導指出此為Frontier計畫試點，涵蓋Word、Excel與PowerPoint，預設關閉、需管理員開啟，預覽階段不含歐盟／EFTA／英國，模型依xAI條款託管，並非Grok 4.7全面上市。
items_flat.analysis_en: This widens xAI’s enterprise distribution through Microsoft’s work surface, but admin opt-in and regional carve-outs limit immediate scale. It does not substitute for an official Grok 4.7 model card, which xAI still has not published.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這擴大了xAI經微軟工作介面進入企業的通路，但管理員開啟與地區排除會限制即時規模。它不能取代尚未出現的Grok 4.7官方模型說明。
items_flat.quote: More model choice coming to Copilot. Welcome Grok!
items_flat.quote_zh: 更多模型選擇即將進入Copilot。歡迎Grok！

items_flat.title_en: DeepSeek begins routing V4-Pro API traffic to V4.1-Flash
items_flat.summary_en: DeepSeek’s official API notes say that from 04:00 UTC on September 14, 2026, requests to deepseek-v4-pro will route to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at Flash rates until V4.1-Pro launches. V4.1-Flash is the new multimodal MoE in its architecture family, live as deepseek-flash; older V4-Flash names are compatibility aliases.
items_flat.summary_zh: DeepSeek官方API說明寫明，自2026年9月14日04:00 UTC起，對deepseek-v4-pro的請求將改送DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash並按Flash計價，直到V4.1-Pro上線。V4.1-Flash是新架構系列的多模態MoE，API名稱為deepseek-flash；舊V4-Flash名稱僅作相容別名。
items_flat.analysis_en: The in-window event is a production routing and pricing cutover, not a brand-new paper drop today. Customers still on the Pro alias should expect Flash behavior and Flash bills unless DeepSeek later restores a separate Pro SKU.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 窗口內發生的是生產環境路由與計價切換，而非今日全新論文發表。仍使用Pro別名的客戶應預期Flash行為與Flash帳單，除非之後另上獨立Pro品項。
items_flat.quote: Starting at 04:00 UTC on Sept 14, 2026, all deepseek-v4-pro requests will route to V4.1-Flash at V4.1-Flash rates. This will continue until V4.1-Pro launches.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自2026年9月14日04:00 UTC起，所有deepseek-v4-pro請求將改送V4.1-Flash並按V4.1-Flash費率計價，直至V4.1-Pro上線。

items_flat.title_en: Safety researchers from Anthropic and DeepMind join METR
items_flat.summary_en: Joe Benton, who said he left Anthropic’s safety team, announced he is joining independent evaluator METR and argued companies are racing toward systems smarter than any human. Coverage also says Josh Engels moved from Google DeepMind to METR. The moves sit beside Amodei’s plan, which named METR as an example embedded evaluator.
items_flat.summary_zh: 自稱已離開Anthropic安全團隊的Joe Benton宣布加入獨立評估機構METR，並認為各公司正競相打造強過人的系統。報導亦指Josh Engels從Google DeepMind轉至METR。此事與Amodei方案並列，該方案點名METR作為嵌入評估者示例。
items_flat.analysis_en: Talent flowing into the evaluator named in the pacing plan is a structural signal, but METR’s forthcoming access rights at each lab are not yet public contracts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 人才流向調速方案點名的評估機構是結構訊號，但METR在各實驗室的實際存取權尚未見公開合約。

brief_en: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei called for pacing frontier capabilities and pledged embedded third-party evaluators; Sam Altman said OpenAI will match that access and ruled out a 2026 IPO. Microsoft made Grok selectable in Copilot. DeepSeek’s V4.1-Flash routing change hits today.
brief_zh: Anthropic執行長Amodei呼籲放慢前沿能力並承諾嵌入第三方評估；Altman表示OpenAI將比照辦理，並排除2026年IPO。微軟讓Grok可在Copilot選用。DeepSeek V4.1-Flash今日開始改路由。
